headline: Regis overtake unbeaten CSU Pueblo at the top
dek: Regis won at Colorado School of Mines for their eleventh win of the season, while CSU Pueblo were held at UCCS. Regis have not lost since UCCS beat them early in October; CSU Pueblo have not lost at all.
displaced_by: Regis now lead the table after CSU Pueblo's draw at UCCS; the standing dek named CSU Pueblo as the side above Regis and had them still to play UCCS.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: South Dakota Mines have scored more goals than Colorado School of Mines and Adams State together, but have also conceded 28; scoring is not what separates the top of the table.

wire.line: Regis have won every match since UCCS beat them and now lead an unbeaten CSU Pueblo.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day; none is a score gap.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado School of Mines have yet to win this season, with three draws and fifteen defeats, the latest at home to Regis.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Adams State have scored eight goals this season and conceded 50.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: CSU Pueblo's Nick Cenek has eleven goals and four assists this season, from 57 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UCCS's Hugo Sjöberg has made 66 saves this season and conceded fifteen goals.

last_match.line: CSU Pueblo have still to lose this season; UCCS have beaten Regis home and away.

next_match.line: Fort Lewis have already beaten South Dakota Mines at home this season; only CSU Pueblo, UCCS and Regis have beaten them since conference play opened.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
